verdicts.reason: The two are almost pixel-identical. Both use a reasonable banner layout: logo and headline on the left, product can on the green circle at right. Both share the same flaws: the 'fizz' end of the headline runs into the green circle, the body copy is tiny (~9px) and sits on the yellow circle, and the bottom row is cramped against the bottom edge. The CTA in A is a few pixels tighter to the right edge than in B, a negligible difference.
